amendments.ownerDecision: Repair automatic distribution in the signature email-link e-signature system without affecting available systems; preserve existing manual backup designs.
sourceFindings: Recipient selection deduplicates by normalized email, merging distinct signer positions that share an address.
Recipient selection filters to Signed signers and excludes invited signer positions not in Signed state.
Completion email delivery bypasses the existing bounded retry helper and makes one automatic attempt; the retry endpoint is separate and owner-triggered.
The completion email callback does not pass smtpSend's existing onStage callback, so individual SMTP stage evidence is not persisted.
Personal My Documents copies are restricted to Signed signers with a profile UID.

approvedScope.recipientIdentity: Stable document-owner identity and one stable signer-position identity per envelope signer ID; never deduplicate by email.
approvedScope.recipients: Document owner plus every invited signer/email-link assignment in the envelope; forwarded-link holders are not added as recipients.
approvedScope.retries: At most three automatic attempts for known transient/pre-submit failures and explicit SMTP 4xx rate-limit responses. Authentication, invalid recipient, mailbox-full, permanent failures and ambiguous SUBMIT outcomes are not retried.
approvedScope.audit: Persist bounded, sanitised per-attempt BUILD_MESSAGE, SMTP_CONNECT, SMTP_AUTH, RCPT_ACCEPTED and SUBMIT stage outcomes.
approvedScope.personalCopies: Keep one independent My Documents copy per eligible profile UID, including profile holders among invited signer positions; email-only participants continue to receive email without a profile copy.
approvedScope.manualBackup: Do not remove, redesign, disable or replace existing manual tracking, first-send/retry controls, recovery assessment, backup-first retry, or fallback paths.

invariants: Completed remains independent of email delivery.
No changes to signatures, signer identity, tokens, links, sessions, fields, stamping, PDF building, hashes, certificates or authoritative archive writes.
No Firestore rules, SMTP settings, secrets, Worker bindings, credentials or production envelope mutations.
Sent and Unknown outcomes are not automatically resent; ambiguous SUBMIT outcomes remain Unknown.
Manual backup and recovery designs remain intact.
